text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ritto dorm has a year-end tradition<n>where the
students show their<n>appreciation for the staff by
taking<n>over for a day of thorough cleaning.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It looks like we're on kitchen duty<n>this year. And it
sure seems to be<n>crying out for help, huh, Dia?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! This is my first time cleaning a<n>kitchen, but
I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, you've never cleaned a kitchen<n>before?
You're kidding, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, I really haven't. My parents<n>always hired
professionals to do it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well, there's nothing to worry about!<n>It's not all
that different from cleaning<n>anything else.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Now let's see... Why don't we start<n>by organizing
the fridge!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Put anything that smells funny or is<n>past the
expiration date in this bag.<n>It's probably gone bad,
so we'll just<n>toss it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Got it. It looks like this bread expires<n>on—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
C'mon! Who put the Toughness Bars<n>in the
freezer?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I put them in there in the summer!<n>They're great
frozen. I guess<n>they've been in there ever since.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Trash! Toss 'em!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what's in this container I<n>found in the
back? I'm going to open<n>it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh! It smells sour! What in the world<n>is this?
Shaved woodchips?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Why are woodchips in the fridge?<n>This is definitely
trash!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia, wait! That's salted rice-bran!<n>Don't throw it
away!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? It's food? But it smells so<n>strange... I've
never seen anything<n>like it.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh, I guess you wouldn't have.<n>Rice bran is for
making pickles.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's no better way to learn than<n>to try it
yourself! Let's have some<n>pickled daikon!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
These really are pickles, through and<n>through! I
can't believe rice bran<n>gives it this flavor!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. This rice bran has been<n>passed down
through generations of<n>Ritto Dorm students!
Careful, though.<n>Once you start eating pickles made
from it, it's hard to stop!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
My, that does look delicious. Be sure<n>to get back to
cleaning after you've<n>finished.

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Okaaay!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's clean the vents and<n>the stove.
Those grease stains look<n>pretty tough.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I brought the power washer! The<n>cleaning staff
said it can handle even<n>the toughest stains! They
showed me<n>how to use it as well.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: The power washer? Dia, wai—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I just have to connect the hose, point<n>it at the mess,
and... go!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Aaaaah! Gyaaah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey! You're getting everyone wet!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I was too slow to stop her... Dia,<n>power washers
get water<n>everywhere, so we need to be careful
where we use them.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! Now that you mention it, I think<n>the staff said
they use it to clean the<n>bath.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not only did I not help out, I made the<n>mess even
worse...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's totally fine. You said it was your<n>first time, so it
makes sense that you<n>wouldn't know.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I didn't know a bunch of stuff when I<n>first moved
into the dorm, and all I did<n>was make mistakes.
You'll learn it all<n>as you go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right. I tell you what. Next time<n>it's my turn
to clean, I'll let you do it.<n>♪ You need the experience,
right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look! The places Dia washed<n>are totally
spotless!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
That power washer is amazing! All<n>we have to do is
wipe up the water<n>and we'll be done!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Um... I actually brought something else<n>with me as
well...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan and Sweep
text_block_list.text:
All right! Go, go, go! Just like that!<n>That's right, suck
it all up! Looking<n>good!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, robotic vacuums are so much<n>fun! I just
want to keep cheering it<n>on!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe. I guess this time I was<n>actually helpful!
Thank goodness!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Every nook and cranny is<n>immaculate... Great work,
everyone!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! It's all thanks to the power<n>cleaner Dia
brought!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We all did it together. I'm just glad it<n>came in
handy!
